system.description:
The character is harmed by exposure to a substance or material. Contact damage varies based on exposure and rarity.
Rank 1: The Bane causes the character minor damage: 10 damage per round of exposure.
Rank 2: The Bane causes the character moderate damage: 20 damage per round of exposure.
Rank 3: The Bane causes the character major damage: 30 damage per round of exposure.
